title: Viunganishi (Theme 3: Mavazi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child reads both parts and chooses the joining word by what the second part does to the first (adds, opposes, gives a reason, gives a result).
representations: two sentence strips joined by a card
an arrow for cause and result
a chart: na, lakini, kwa sababu, kwa hiyo, au
steps: Ask: adds, opposes, reason or result?

board.say: Sehemu ya pili inakubaliana au inapinga?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child chooses "lakini" and writes one sentence with "kwa sababu".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Alitaka kuogelea, ___ ziwa lilikuwa na mawimbi makali." Kwa nini "kwa sababu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kila kiunganishi kina kazi: "lakini" kinaonyesha kinyume, "kwa sababu" kinatoa sababu, "ili" kinaonyesha kusudi, "na" kinaongeza.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Juma ___ Otieno ni marafiki." Kwa nini "rafiki" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kiunganishi huunganisha maneno au sentensi, kama "na", "lakini" na "kwa sababu". Si nomino wala kitenzi.

misconceptions.ask: Sehemu ya pili inakubaliana au inapingana na ya kwanza?
misconceptions.repair: Sehemu ya pili inapingana na ya kwanza, kwa hiyo tumia lakini.

misconceptions.ask: Ni lipi lilitokea kwanza: kuugua au kutokuja?
misconceptions.repair: Kuwa mgonjwa ni sababu, kwa hiyo tumia kwa sababu.
